## Verification

- [ ] `make check` passes (fmt, vet, lint, tests with `-race`)
- [ ] `make e2e-full` passes — **the gate**; a spec that was green and now fails
      is a regression, not a flake
- [ ] New behaviour has an E2E spec, or there is a reason it does not need one
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits (`make tools` installs the hook)
